summary: Pyxis Tankers Inc., a Greek international shipping company, filed a Form 6-K on April 24, 2026, announcing that CFO Henry Williams will step down at the end of April 2026, with Fotis Giannakoulis assuming the role effective May 1, 2026. No financial terms, consideration, premium, or board recommendation were disclosed. The transition is a voluntary change in senior management. The company expressed appreciation for Williams and highlighted Giannakoulis's 25 years of ship finance experience at Morgan Stanley, Fearnleys, and ABN AMRO. This is a routine CFO succession and does not trigger any special situation or risk-arb angle; watch for any strategic shifts under the new CFO.
